emerging_technology: Agentic AI systems: an integrated language model, model-selected tools, observations, permissions and human stopping authority for bounded multi-step digital work. This is the system under analysis, not a single model, chart plugin or all of generative AI.
intended_application: A proposed human-supervised chart-review workflow: compare business charts and claims with approved source tables using read-only tools, then draft corrections for a named human reviewer. No autonomous publication or financial/customer decisions.
business_need: Investigate whether review effort can be reduced while maintaining source traceability and correct interpretation.
management_question: Is this organization ready for a four-week isolated public/synthetic chart-review learning exercise, and what would separately be required to sustain routine use? Identify one binding factor, proportionate actions and decision-critical missing evidence.
time_horizon: Four-week learning proposal, with a two-week evidence review if execution is blocked; routine sustainability considered separately before a future operating release.
organization: Hypothetical Organization A: a mid-sized US financial-services reporting operation
industry_sector: Regulated financial services and internal management reporting.
users_stakeholders: Reporting sponsor, reporting manager, BI review lead, reporting process owner, security/data authority, finance owner, model-risk officer, service owner/deputy, affected analysts and executives. These are relevant roles, not actual appointments.
adoption_posture: Conservative, risk-aware and open to proportionate learning after specific authorization. Posture does not replace evidence or safeguards.
